args.body: For SQLITE-INTERNATIONAL-CAD-PAYMENT-TEST, reuse any committed first-party payment evidence before reading the queued Interac capture. If the capture commits and fits the existing mission scope, cite the exact sender and recipient requirements and assess whether a buyer located abroad could satisfy them. Keep buyer access to a participating account, operator acceptance and verified settlement separate. If the source leaves compatibility unresolved, preserve the precise question to ask a real eligible buyer. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson when the mission criteria are met. No account creation, test transfer or payment request.
